cover: Riots paralyze France as drone waves strike deep inside Russia
cover_scene: A split view of burning Parisian barricades shrouded in tear gas and an industrial oil refinery engulfed in flames at night under heavy smoke

slides.scene: Riot police with shields confronting burning barricades and tear gas along an empty Parisian boulevard at dusk
slides.headline: Widespread Riots and Arrests Shake France
slides.body: Over 1,800 people were arrested across France following chaotic nationwide protests over living costs and social security policies. Demonstrations devolved into violent clashes, arson, and looting, prompting President Emmanuel Macron to condemn the violence and demand order.

slides.scene: A military attack helicopter flying low over rugged desert mountains along the Saudi-Yemeni frontier under a dusty sky
slides.headline: Helicopter Downed Along Saudi-Yemen Border
slides.body: Yemeni forces claimed they shot down a Saudi Apache helicopter over the southern Najran border region, while Saudi sources confirmed two crew members died in a crash. The incident marks a sharp escalation as regional cross-border hostilities intensify.

slides.scene: Industrial fuel storage tanks engulfed in massive fireballs under a night sky with smoke billowing over Saint Petersburg
slides.headline: Ukrainian Drones Strike Saint Petersburg Oil Facilities
slides.body: Ukraine launched a massive aerial assault involving over 1,000 drones against targets deep inside Russia, igniting major fires at oil facilities in Saint Petersburg. The strike killed at least one person, marking a major expansion of Kyiv's long-range campaign.

slides.scene: Emergency vehicles and fire engines outside a smoke-filled military barracks installation in the flat Alberta landscape
slides.headline: Fatal Fire Breaks Out at Canadian Base
slides.body: Multiple people died and others were injured after a major fire broke out at Canadian Forces Base Wainwright in Alberta. Defense authorities deployed emergency responders to contain the blaze and launched an official investigation into the cause of the disaster.
